description: This file defines the 'SystemCheckAPI' class, which is a REST API controller for performing system checks during the upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes SystemCheck utility to provide results and status of system health checks.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller to perform system health checks during system upgrade.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve system check results and status.
